blocks.text: EXCLUSIVE: Tomorrow brings the start of a Winnipeg shoot for Homesick , an indie horror thriller to star Mena Suvari ( American Beauty ), David Arquette ( Scream franchise), Belle Shouse (Netflix’s Monsters: The Lyle and Erik Menendez Story ) and Alberto Rosende ( Chicago Fire ).

From Evoke Entertainment and Freefall Films , the film revolves around Suvari’s Dr. Abby Morrison, a compassionate physician whose carefully built life conceals a secret she has never shared with her husband. With their daughter away at college, Abby and husband Gordy (Arquette) are settling into life as empty nesters when the arrival of a mysterious young woman (Shouse) shatters their sense of safety. As an unsettling encounter spirals into a nightmare, the couple must fight to protect each other in a home they can no longer trust.

Todd Slavkin , a veteran of shows like Shadowhunters , The Mysterious Benedict Society and Smallville , is directing from a script written with longtime writing and producing partner Darren Swimmer. Stan Spry, Henry Boger and Anthony Fankhauser are producing; Jeff Holland, Geoff Silverman, Slavkin and Swimmer are exec producing; and Pam Mitchell is co-producing.

Slavkin and Swimmer are repped by Evoke Entertainment, IAG, and Gendler, Kelly & Cunningham. Suvari is repped by Innovative, Management Production Entertainment, and Jackoway Austen Tyerman; Arquette by Artium Talent, Lighthouse Entertainment, and Brecheen Feldman. Breimer; Shouse by Innovative, Industry Entertainment, and Meyer & Downs; and Rosende by Yorn, Levine, Barnes.
